claim.pdf_says: SW CLOSE { file-name-1 [ {REEL | UNIT} [FOR REMOVAL] | WITH {NO REWIND | LOCK} ] } ...  (one left brace before file-name-1, drawn as a single brace spanning the bracket, with CLOSE to its left)
claim.why_it_matters: The drawn SW CLOSE format is misaligned: the middle row 'SW        <u>CLOSE</u> ┤ file-name-1   │ ... │ ├ …' is shifted about nine columns right of the other six rows. In the rendered figure the outer brace (column of ╭ ┤ │ ┤ ╰) stands to the RIGHT of where CLOSE prints, the bracket's left edge (┌/└ at the column of file-name-1) cuts through 'file-name-1', and its right edge and closing brace on that row sit beyond the ┐/╮ of the rows above. The outer brace also carries three ┤ middle marks. The geometry no longer shows that file-name-1 and the optional REEL/UNIT-or-WITH bracket are inside one repeated brace; the intended syntax is recoverable only by reading the glyphs in order.

verdict.reasoning: Printed page V-21 (PDF p.213) shows SW CLOSE followed by one tall left brace enclosing file-name-1 and a bracket holding two stacked choices ({REEL|UNIT} [FOR REMOVAL] over WITH {NO REWIND|LOCK}), closing bracket, closing brace, then '...'; CLOSE is outside (left of) the brace. Counting rendered columns of page-213.md (tags stripped): rows 24-26 and 28-30 put the outer brace at column 9, bracket left edge at 23, bracket right edge at 47, closing brace at 49. Row 27 puts CLOSE at columns 10-14 (inside/right of the column-9 brace stroke), its brace middle mark at 16, the bracket bar at 32 (cutting through where file-name-1 sits relative to rows above), the right bar at 55 and closing brace at 57. Raw text with <u> tags is even further right, so neither view aligns. The figure's geometry therefore places the outer brace's stroke left of CLOSE on six of seven rows, making CLOSE appear inside the repeated group, and rows 25/29 carry extra ┤ middle marks. All glyphs are present in the right order, so the syntax is recoverable by sequential reading, but the drawn grouping of the general format is wrong: a genuine figure defect, as claimed.
verdict.corrected_description: Claim is accurate in substance. Precisely: the middle row is shifted 7 columns right at the outer brace (col 16 vs 9) and 8-9 columns at the bracket edges (32 vs 23; 55 vs 47), so the outer brace column on the other six rows falls left of CLOSE, drawing CLOSE inside the repeated brace; the outer brace also has spurious ┤ marks on rows 25 and 29. Content tokens are complete and in order.
